# IRS fixture provenance

`county_inflow_travis.csv` and `county_outflow_travis.csv` are fresh real rows
captured 2026-07-13 from the official IRS SOI 2022-2023 county migration CSVs.
They preserve the published column names and Travis County total-migration rows.
`soi_migration.csv` remains a compact normalized-loader fixture. The official-layout
fixtures are live-confirmed.
